changes.evidence: Luke Cage S1: after Cottonmouth's death Diamondback takes command of the Stokes Crime Family's men and makes Zip his adviser; in episode 12 Zip tries to strangle Shades on Diamondback's own orders ('I was just following orders', he admits Diamondback gave the order) and Shades shoots him dead. Zip never quits or turns on his boss (Diamondback's record keeps the Stokes Crime Family with no departure), and death is not a departure, so the Independent stage and the left at Luke Cage S1 have no move behind them.

Luke Cage S2: from episode 1 D.W. runs his Luke Cage merchandise business out of Pop's Barber Shop, and in episode 13 he pays Ms. Hopson and takes over the barbershop's lease ('I'm taking over the lease of the barbershop... this place is Switzerland'), telling Luke he bought the shop. The MCU Wiki lists Pop's Barber Shop as his affiliation. An owned workplace counts as a group (as Bobby Fish's record keeps Pop's Barber Shop).

Jessica Jones S3: Kith and Peter own the Zoey Lyonne Art School (shown in episode 1, AKA The Perfect Burger), where Kith teaches classes (Jeri finds her after one of her classes), and they run its Zoey Lyonne Foundation, whose fraud drives Kith's case. Her workplace is a group under the employer rule, so 'Independent' is wrong.

Ironheart episode 4 (Bad Magic): Madeline, who trained at Kamar-Taj and left it for Chicago to raise Zelma, runs her own shop, Stanton's Sweets, Reads & More, where Ronnie brings Riri to her. She leaves the Masters for a workplace she owns, so her last stage is the shop, not Independent.
Same move as above: after leaving Kamar-Taj she runs Stanton's Sweets, Reads & More (Ironheart episode 4), so she does not end up in no group; remove the left at Ironheart.

owner_calls.question: Iron Fist S1 episode 3 tells that young Jeri was an intern in the legal department at Rand Enterprises under Wendell Rand. Under the past-group rule, should Rand Enterprises be a first stage keyed to Jessica Jones S1, or is an internship told once too minor a job?
options: Add ["Rand Enterprises", "Jessica Jones S1"] before Hogarth, Chao & Benowitz
Keep as is (an internship told once does not count)
owner_calls.evidence: Danny to Jeri in Rolling Thunder Cannon Punch: 'You were an intern in the legal department in my dad's office? You called his secretary Margaret a hatchet-faced bitch.' The MCU Wiki lists Rand Enterprises (formerly) in her affiliations.

owner_calls.question: Sheikh Abdullah is the imam of Kamala's mosque in Ms. Marvel (he lectures there, hosts Eid and turns Damage Control away from it). Does his mosque count as his workplace group, and under what name?
options: Add the mosque as his group (the MCU Wiki calls it the Islamic Masjid of Jersey City; the name the screen uses is unconfirmed)
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU Wiki gives his affiliation as the Islamic Masjid of Jersey City and an on-screen handle 'SheikhAbdullahJCIC' (episode 6); it is a real workplace, but the brief says how far employers go is the owner's call and the mosque's on-screen name is not confirmed.
